premises.text: Hair styling is central to self-expression but the hair industry is largely offline and hard to find stylists in
premises.evidence_span: the industry isn't online, and so it's hard to find a stylist

premises.text: Independent stylists lack websites, client tracking, marketing email, and online scheduling so they cannot actively grow
premises.evidence_span: She doesn't have a website. She doesn't track client information or send marketing emails. She doesn't have daily access to her schedule because her salon doesn't have an online system

premises.text: StyleSeat gives professionals a website with social sharing and specials so clients can help grow the business
premises.evidence_span: with StyleSeek, Glenda gets her own website. So for the first time, she can actually control her visibility online

premises.text: Clients can search local professionals, filter, book online including last-minute slots, and get reminders plus recommendation prompts
premises.evidence_span: I can go to styleseat.com, type in haircut San Francisco, get a search results page with a bunch of professionals in my area

premises.text: Professionals get schedule access, client CRM, marketing tools, education, dashboard metrics, and demand-based specials to grow revenue
premises.evidence_span: Now Glenda has direct access to her schedule for the first time. She has all her client information in one place. She can send marketing emails to them

premises.text: Freemium model with free online booking and scheduling makes the platform available to the entire industry
premises.evidence_span: We have freemium model, free online booking, free scheduling, so we're available for the entire industry

domains.name: Offline hair professionals who cannot grow

value.text: Bring the hair industry online so clients find and book stylists and professionals actively grow their businesses
value.evidence_span: StyleSeed is bringing this $40 billion industry online starting today

secondary_value.text: Unlock inefficiency by freeing unused marketing capital and making matching more efficient
secondary_value.evidence_span: StyleSeat will unlock $18 billion in inefficiency in the space

causal_links.evidence_span: she can't take an active role in growing it
the first time, Glenda can actively grow her business
we're available for the entire industry

notes: App/iPad launch and future schedule optimization folded into professional tools per v1.3.2 4.1(5). Traction (10k professionals, school deals) excluded per 4.2. Launch credit promo excluded as financing/marketing ask. Aestheticians/trainers extension treated as same professional-tools mechanism, not a separate premise. Singleton D3: freemium availability is separately revisable commercial design.
